topic: Mastering the Product Rule and Chain Rule in Calculus

sections.title: Prerequisite Warm-up: The Concept of Rate
lecture_lines: Derivative is the instantaneous rate of change.
Imagine a cheetah running at speed f.
We need rules for complex functions.
animations: Display 'Rate' text in #FFFFFF at screen center.

sections.title: The Product Rule: The 'Teamwork' Rule
lecture_lines: Rectangle area is u(x) times v(x).
Changing both sides adds u'v + uv'.

sections.title: The Chain Rule: The 'Nested' Rule
lecture_lines: Chain rule handles nested functions f(g(x)).

sections.title: Integrated Application: The 'Super-Combo'
lecture_lines: Identify outer and inner functions first.
animations: Apply Product and Chain rules simultaneously.

sections.title: Summary & Quick Check
lecture_lines: Follow the Identify, Apply, Simplify workflow.
